text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's still time today to do some more
training.
I ask the students gathered on
the racetrack what
they'd like to do.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I want to do some partner running!
Prez is
here too, so there's no better
chance to run with
her!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm feeling good today, so I want to
use this
opportunity to hone my running
technique as
much as possible!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Physical activity is good, but how
about looking to the wisdom of the
racing greats? By reading of their deeds,
we can heighten our collective
knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As a matter of fact, I heard that a new
manual has
been added to the library's
collection.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the proposals sound good to me. If I
were to
choose something we could all
do together,
though...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then it's decided. Everyone, go get
changed.
We'll meet outside after. Make
sure to stay warm,
all right?
choice_data_list: How about deepening your running k...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let us read our way to greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what I'm talking about!
Running's more
fun when you have
company!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! What are we waiting for? You'd
better get
a move on if you want to beat
me, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I don't know how long this healthy
streak will
last, so I want to make it
count!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'm going to put everything I've got into—cough, cough! Sorry about that! I mean, I'll give it my all while making sure I don't overdo it!
